Captures audio via OS audio
API

Pushes lifecycle/peer-arrival
events to registered

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
A meeting participant taking
notes while audio is captured
and transcribed locally.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
System-provided audio input
device, surfaced through the
OS audio API (WASAPI /
CoreAudio / ALSA /
PulseAudio).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
GGUF and ONNX model files
cached under the app data
directory. Downloaded on
first run from a vendored
manifest.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Static HTTPS host serving
signed update artefacts for
tauri-plugin-updater. Updater
is implemented (wired in
app-main via UpdaterExt);
release config — endpoints +
minisign pubkey — is pending.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Connects over Streamable HTTP
(loopback). Reads meetings +
messages the internal agent
over the agent-tools
registry. Optional; requires
the MCP server to be enabled.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Optional user-configured
local LLM backend reachable
over loopback HTTP. Default
disabled.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Self-hosted iroh relay.
Brokers QUIC connectivity
(NAT traversal / fallback)
between a user's paired
devices. Sees ciphertext only
— never meeting plaintext.
Server-side only, never
shipped.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Android Capacitor app in the
sibling minutist-mobile repo.
Bundles the sync-ffi .so and
calls its UniFFI surface to
join the same paired-device
sync mesh as the desktop and
the headless hub.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Tauri desktop application.
Records audio, transcribes
locally via llama.cpp, takes
hand-typed notes alongside,
summarises with a local LLM.
